messages.content: 中國在2000年和2010年的人口密度是多少，假設2000年的人口為12.67億，2010年的人口為13.41億，而土地面積保持在959.7萬平方公里不變？

function.name: calculate_density
function.description: Calculate the population density of a specific country in a specific year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which the density needs to be calculated.

year.description: The year in which the density is to be calculated.

population.description: The population of the country. This is a float type value.

land_area.description: The land area of the country in square kilometers. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "中國在2000年和2010年的人口密度是多少，假設2000年的人口為12.67億，2010年的人口為13.41億，而土地面積保持在959.7萬平方公里不變？" They want population density for China in 2000 and 2010. They give population numbers: 12.67 billion (12.67億) and 13.41 billion (13.41億). Land area: 959.7 million square kilometers (959.7萬平方公里). Actually 959.7 million square kilometers? Wait 959.7 million square kilometers is huge. China area is about 9.597 million km^2. So they likely mean 959.7万平方公里 = 9.597 million km^2. So we need to compute density = population / land area. Population in billions, area in million km^2. So convert to same units: population in billions -> 12.67 * 1e9. Area in million km^2 -> 9.597 * 1e6 km^2. So density = (12.67e9) / (9.597e6) = about 1320 people per km^2. Let's compute precisely: 12.67e9 / 9.597e6 = 1320.5. For 2010: 13.41e9 / 9.597e6 = 1397.5. So answer: 2000: ~1320 people/km^2; 2010: ~1398 people/km^2.

We should use the function calculate_density. We need to call it twice. Provide arguments: country: "China", year: "2000", population: 12.67e9, land_area: 9.597e6. Then again for 2010. Use the function.
